messages:
zoe (eng-security): Heads up — noticed a weird spike in GPU pool attach failures and a suspicious ClusterRoleBinding that grants `impersonate` to a deploy service account. can we triage? :eyes:
raj (eng-runtime): which binding? can you paste `kubectl get clusterrolebinding` line?
zoe (eng-security): `crb: infra-deploy-sa-impersonate` shows `subjects: serviceAccount:deploy:deploy-sa` and role has `verbs: [\"impersonate\"]` on `users`/`serviceaccounts`. looked like it was added during last week's mesh rollout.
nicole (eng-sre): omg that explains the GPU attach noise — we rely on SA impersonation flow for autoscaler, if mis-scoped it can let pods escalate to node-level access. severity? we should rotate tokens for affected SAs and restrict immediately.
zoe (eng-security): severity: medium for now (no confirmed data exfil). timeline: binding created 1767990000 by CI. we don't see corresponding KMS decrypt entries for the pod tokens though — audit logs aren't showing decrypt attempts for the KMS key used by deploy-sa.
raj (eng-runtime): audit-bot: checking logs for KMS decrypt and iam:dryRun. deploy-bot: triggered an automated freeze on rollouts for deploy-sa.
deploy-bot: Rollouts for namespace 'deploy' paused (reason: suspicious CRB impersonate grant). See /deploy/actions/1768129999.
audit-bot: checked cloud audit: no KMS CryptoKeyDecrypt events tied to the key id xxxxx-ckey for the last 48h. There are `serviceAccountToken` requests though.
zoe (eng-security): suspect two issues: 1) RBAC change too permissive (impersonate on wildcard subjects), 2) audit pipeline missing token->KMS linkage (we can't map SA token decrypts to KMS events).
nicole (eng-sre): mitigation plan: 1) remove impersonate verb from that CRB, 2) create a constrained RoleBinding for autoscaler with allowed target SAs, 3) add an admit webhook to block future `impersonate` grants in infra namespaces. I can run the patch if you approve.
raj (eng-runtime): agree. quick patch:
```
kubectl patch clusterrolebinding infra-deploy-sa-impersonate -p '{"roleRef":{"name":"infra-deploy-no-impersonate"}}'
```
but better to create a new ClusterRole that drops impersonate and update roleRef.
zoe (eng-security): please also add this to audit trail: file a ticket and annotate CRB with `redwood:investigation=1768129999`. we need for compliance.
raj (eng-runtime): creating PR to replace roleRef and add tests in admission-checks. PR link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/merge/3456 :thumbsup:
nicole (eng-sre): rotating tokens: I'll force a token sync for deploy-sa and rotate the KMS envelope keys for the affected keyring. commands I'll run:
```
kubectl delete secret deploy-sa-token-*
gcloud kms keys versions destroy --key=ckey --location=us-central1 --keyring=infra-kr --version=latest
```
(we'll schedule zero-downtime rotation)
zoe (eng-security): also please update logging mapping: augment the audit pipeline to include `token_id` from K8s audit and map to KMS request metadata. audit-bot flagged a missing field.
audit-bot: logged enhancement request AE-2197 to pipeline team.
raj (eng-runtime): temporary guard: added OPA rule to deny ClusterRoleBindings with `verbs` containing `impersonate` unless annotation `approved-by:sec` present. pushed gate to prod admission controller.
```
package rbac
deny["impersonate-not-approved"] {
  input.requestObject.kind == "ClusterRoleBinding"
  some i
  input.requestObject.subjects[i].kind == "ServiceAccount"
  input.requestObject.roleRef.name == "*"
  contains(input.requestObject.rules[_].verbs, "impersonate")
  not input.requestObject.metadata.annotations.approved-by
}
```
zoe (eng-security): nice. follow-ups: 1) postmortem stub, 2) update onboarding docs to forbid impersonate in infra CRBs, 3) run cluster-wide RBAC audit to find other mis-scoped impersonate grants. I'll own the PB.
nicole (eng-sre): running `rbac-audit --find impersonate` now, output will be attached to ticket. :lock:
zoe (eng-security): thanks all. we should keep this thread as the source of truth for audit. ping me if you find a service account with unexpected node privileges.
raj (eng-runtime): will follow up in PR comments with exact diffs. closing temporary freeze after token rotation completes.
zoe (eng-security): closing note: no signs of exfil so far, but because audit linkage is weak, extend log retention for KMS events for 30d. filing CHG to do that.
